inventory_provenance: button-completion-audit-next28.json (same pinned source); this audit updates remaining contracts rather than recertifying every method

remaining_contracts.current_mapping_and_limit: Fixed/grow current-frame label clipping/nowrap/ellipsis implemented, full semantic name preserved; arbitrary custom nested whitespace remains caller-owned.

remaining_contracts.contract_and_source: Public `Styled` refinement and Base semantic state styles, Base Button `135-181`, Components Button `580-584,611-613,722-723,792-804`
remaining_contracts.current_mapping_and_limit: Public Core composition and Button custom colors/geometry/slots cover parts; there is no arbitrary Button root style refinement replayed after each selected/disabled state. Do not equate a palette override with the full style contract.

remaining_contracts.contract_and_source: Gradient-backed theme surfaces and Oklab transparent mixing, Button `899-988,1100-1273`, tests `1812-1868`
remaining_contracts.current_mapping_and_limit: Button palettes hold RGBA colors, not source Background gradients. Alpha multiplication and supplied outline colors are not Oklab interpolation. This needs a separate paint/theme contract, not another variant enum.

Core now supports bounded value-owned drop shadows, but Button has no shadow option and theme has no equivalent global shadow enable flag. Only Custom requests shadow in the pinned Button: built-in variants do **not** require invented shadows. Loading opacity applies to the entire shadow/button; disabled suppresses shadow. GPUI `shadow_xs` is one black alpha .05 layer, offset `(0,1)`, `blur_radius=2`, from pinned dependency macro `gpui-pre-macros-0.3.8/src/styles.rs:416-424`; use the already audited blur conversion rather than guessing its sigma semantics.

CUI paints a two-pixel border in theme focus color whenever focus-visible and not hidden. Source distinguishes outside three-pixel alpha-.5 ring, border tint without layout changes, and borderless Edge/Inside/Outside fallback lines when theme ring is off. Source filled fallback uses foreground alpha .6; outside/inside gap is .125 rem. Theme `hide_focus_ring` and Core current-frame outline/prepaint support exist, but the Button implementation does not use them for this exact policy. Also source borders are limited to Default or outline (`Button:700-703`), whereas CUI non-borderless variants generally use a one-pixel border.

Core public tab-stop API sets only 0/-1 and traversal follows semantic order. `skip_tab` is not signed indexed ordering. Full ordering would require an explicitly scoped Core change; it is not Button-only work.

remaining_contracts.contract_and_source: Public role override and explicit focusability, Base `88-128`, styled `326-329`
remaining_contracts.current_mapping_and_limit: CUI derives Button/Link and permits Core semantic refinement; no Button role option or Base `focusable(false)` equivalent option. Late role refinement is not proof that keyboard/accessibility activation preserves the source behavior under every overridden role. Stable Core IDs replace GPUI focus handles without importing platform types.

remaining_contracts.contract_and_source: Native ClickEvent payload and event-local propagation, Base `99-105,248-252`, styled `447-453`
remaining_contracts.current_mapping_and_limit: Standalone callbacks now run once per accepted event; Group requests expose event index and stable target. Standalone callback remains `void(user)` and does not receive pointer/key kind, modifiers or event index. Core frame events and consumption are available for composition, but are not a callback payload/propagation contract. No new bubbling claim follows from accepted target records.

Caller can OR selected with popup-open presentation; there is no independent `open` field. Pinned open is presentation separate from selected/toggled, not an intrinsic menu implementation or automatic expanded metadata requirement. Treat this as a missing direct API convenience/state distinction, not as an absent menu subsystem.

String tooltip, placement, delay/cancel/focus and borrowed state are implemented and tested. Button does not resolve application actions/context into keybinding presentation. A portable application resolver/content contract is needed, not GPUI Action types.

Named/data-backed icons, default animated spinner and named loading-glyph rotation are present; `leading_content` can explicitly compose Spinner/Progress. No typed ButtonIcon adapter preserves a supplied Spinner/Progress through loading automatically. Source creates a spinner only when an icon exists; CUI's loading-only button spinner is an intentional extension. Reduced-motion rotation has headless evidence; full typed-slot preservation is not certified.

CUI supplies a real named chevron and distribution spacer, but uses current foreground unchanged. Source caret uses normal foreground opacity .75, even when label state changes. Exact caret tint and compound-held hover are not covered merely by SVG command count.

Explicit height/font/icon/width overrides and four legacy plus fourteen design sizes are tested. They do not automatically apply the source single-pixel-size rule (icon .75 times size, normal horizontal padding .2 times size). This is an API mapping limit, not a missing fourteen-size implementation.
